specs.Zeb Duke Pro Wireless Headphone: Experience powerful wireless audio with a stylish, modern design built for everyday entertainment and all-day comfort.
specs.Up to 50 Hours Backup: Stay unplugged longer with up to 50 hours of playback (at 70% Volume (ANC OFF)), perfect for extended music sessions, travel, and daily use.
specs.Gaming Mode (Low Latency): Activate low latency mode to minimize audio delay and enjoy smooth, perfectly synced gaming and video playback.
